name: What is the process for implementing AEO for an accounting firm?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for implementing AEO for an accounting firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing AEO typically begins with an audit of your current online presence to identify opportunities for AI optimization. This includes analyzing your website content for semantic relevance, structuring data for AI readability, and optimizing local listings. The process involves refining your service descriptions to align with natural language queries, developing AI-friendly content, and ensuring your digital assets provide clear, concise answers to common client questions. Continuous monitoring and adjustments are also crucial for adapting to evolving AI algorithms.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO implementation involves auditing online presence, structuring data, optimizing content for natural language, and continuously monitoring AI algorithm changes.
